text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then. Let's begin the extraordinary 
meeting.”
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The topic of discussion was, of course—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
About the upcoming hot springs trip, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod together with Air Messiah. Yes, 
after sprinting through the Senior Year, 
things have finally settled down a bit—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was time to finally use the hot springs 
tickets kept since the lottery. That was 
what the two of them had decided.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I made a solid plan together with 
Air Messiah, and then—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... This is the inn, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
5 minutes before check-in time... We've 
arrived right on schedule. We did it, 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, everything went according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was a bit uneasy since it was an 
unfamiliar place, but meticulous planning 
paid off. It seems we managed to reach the 
inn without getting lost.
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's drop off our bags and go 
sightseeing—

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
"—Aww, what a bummer~!! I really wanted to 
go check out the 'Starry Cave.'"

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
Even after walking all over the place 
looking for it~. That map from the tourist 
info center was way too confusing...

text_block_list.name: Tourist C
text_block_list.text:
Hey, we could barely find any of the 
landmarks written there, could we? Well, 
can't be helped—let's just forget about 
it!

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text: Waaah, the starry skyyy...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The "Starry Sky Cave"...?
choice_data_list: Apparently so, at tourist spots like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! Trainer, did you know about this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I confess, feeling a little 
self-conscious. As mentioned earlier, 
since it was a trip to an unfamiliar 
place, no matter how much I prepared, it 
felt like it wasn't enough—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the dates were set, whenever I 
had free time, all I did was research our 
travel destination. Souvenir info, inn 
reviews, restaurant lookups—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had also seen something about the 
"Starry Sky Cave" at the time. It seemed 
like a pretty minor tourist spot, but it's 
apparently a cave covered in unique rock 
faces—
choice_data_list:
I heard the inside looks just like a 
starry sky.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Oh, that... sounds truly beautiful.
choice_data_list:
Interested? If so... wanna go check it 
out?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, but... remembering what those people 
said earlier, won't it be difficult to 
reach?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
! There it... there it is! It really is 
the entrance to a cave...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised. Indeed, the map from the 
tourist information center seemed far too 
outdated to be reliable, so—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Parts of it were practically animal 
trails; it was an extremely convoluted 
route. It's no wonder the folks earlier 
couldn't reach it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
How are you doing this so smoothly, 
Trainer...?
choice_data_list: And from researching too much, no less...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Online reviews and social media posts only 
offered information like "you can't reach 
it." However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After digging as deep as possible across 
the web, an article on a personal blog 
finally turned up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That blog post was the only one that 
provided accurate directions to the cave 
with photos...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "You really are something... ............"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...No. Shall we head inside?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
The "starry sky" inside the cave, I would 
very much like to see it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems no one has stepped in yet, 
so after we secure the safety... right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after checking the safety of the 
surroundings and interior with Air 
Messiah, and leaving a note near the 
entrance just in case...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I stepped into the cave.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...! This is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... It's truly breathtaking—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. Because you were there—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
This view... is something I could only see 
because I was with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Dinner was absolutely exquisite, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...That is true. The plan was to go 
stargazing near the forest path after 
dinner, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I never expected we'd get caught in the 
rain. ...Though the weather did manage to 
hold out during our daytime sightseeing 
and our bath.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Still... I'm not that discouraged.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As for the starry sky, we could already 
view it from the cave.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Would you like to come over to my 
room?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Let us take our time. Though we have 
neither destination nor plan at the 
moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...An inn filled with the sound of rain... 
When you experience it like this, it's 
quite elegant, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though my heart is unwinding. 
......

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...And so. A little—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if I troubled you a 
little, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened my eyes wide in surprise at words 
so uncharacteristic of her. Air Messiah 
gave a somewhat innocent smile, then 
continued.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It was the same today. Yet, it's happened 
countless times before as well."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Time and time again, I have felt it deep 
down... ...Ah, I'm truly glad it was you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I'm truly so glad that the one walking 
beside me is you."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"When I took my very first step, it was 
you who stood by my side."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And so, ...that's why.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm glad it was you. ...And going 
forward, I still want it to be you.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My first step was taken with you. That is 
why I want my final step to be with you as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Until the final moment... when I 
eventually leave the turf."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"From the very first step of my journey to 
the last. I want you by my side through it 
all."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Is that not alright? Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I answer quietly. A smile softens Air 
Messiah's face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Air Messiah...
